title: Chapter 448
paragraphs: Chapter 448
Episode 128. Zephyrine (4)
Huuuwoop!
Zephyrine's throat swelled ominously as she inhaled magical energy.
Murakan, along with Shaku, dropped lightning on her opposite eye, but they couldn't slow down the gathering breath.
It was just a single breath, but the power contained within it was tremendous, enough to surprise even Murakan and Valkas.
However, Jin was able to maintain his composure even though Zephyrine's breath was aimed directly at him.
He was confident.
'Zephyrine won't kill me.'
Or rather, she can't.
Whether it's for the Marasin Stone or creating something terrible, the power of Soldelet that Jin possessed was the most critical element.

As he had deduced during his trainee days, both Zifel and Kinzelo knew how to transfer the divine contract, but Jin thought that this method wouldn't easily apply to him. If it were easy, Zifel, Kinzelo, and Joshua should have been more proactive in killing him.
The fact that Zephyrine wasn't serious in the fight despite having such power was also part of the same story.
'If the goal is to annihilate us, she would have shown much stronger power.'
The power of Zephyrine's single gathered breath was undoubtedly shocking, but it wasn't surprising considering her transcendental martial prowess.
Moreover, it wasn't beyond the level that the group could handle. In other words, Zephyrine had no choice but to forcibly adjust her power to avoid killing Jin.
Kwaaaa-!
As Zephyrine opened her massive jaws, the wind in the empty space began to tremble violently, along with the magical energy.
The force and pressure from the breath she unleashed, the purple rays of breath targeting Jin, were all scattered in every direction.
"Tsk, annoying!"
Murakan quickly descended and blocked Zephyrine's breath. The breath touched the barrier of spiritual energy created by Murakan's wings before reaching the ground.
Most of the magical energy was absorbed into the spiritual energy barrier, but the fragments and other rays that didn't had to be repelled by Shaku and Valkas.
The entire empty space trembled precariously with the energy of the dragons and humans.
Ordinary warriors would have difficulty just enduring the pressure of this battlefield. As power clashed against power, their ears and bones throbbed, and their bodies felt electrifying sensations.
Perhaps because the group defended well, Zephyrine fired a second breath containing even stronger magical energy.
Although she had lived longer than Murakan, like most of her kind, she had never experienced such a fight.
To kill, thoroughly trample, and destroy without a trace.

Such a battle would be no problem, but the situation where Shaku and Valkas had to be killed, Murakan attacked just enough not to be killed, and Jin had to be captured alive was quite frustrating for Zephyrine.
Moreover, it's quite impressive even if it's rotten.
Murakan's resistance was far beyond Zephyrin's expectations. She had heard that he seemed to have regained some of his strength, but she didn't know it would be this much.
Zephyrin also felt it.
'This cunning... You're sure I won't kill you, Jin Runecandle.'
The blue flame surrounding Jin was uncomfortably chilling.
Even at this rate, that flame would soon tear apart a part of the space.
Suddenly, she thought it might have been better to wait for a better opportunity on another day. She might have impulsively caused this situation.
'I can see why the master is keeping an eye on you.'
Crack! Hiss...!
The second breath was neutralized as it collided with the energy barrier.
Although it seemed to be barely focused on defense, Murakan was slowly preparing a counterattack.
[It seems like you've shot enough, the power is quite decent.]
[Your compliment is not very pleasant, haha.]
[Yeah, I guess. And you won't like this either.]
As soon as Murakan finished speaking, the huge barrier divided like a shadow following the light, becoming three parts.
One remained behind Murakan for defense, while the other two took their places on Zephyrin's left and right.

Due to the nature of the energy force, Zephyrin couldn't notice that the barriers were spread on her left and right. It was almost impossible to read the energy, even if the force was enormous, unlike other powers.
The giant body that was several times larger than Murakan also contributed to not being able to confirm the energy barriers on the left and right.
If you can't feel the flow of power, you can only rely on sight.
However, Zephyrin's field of view was limited, and her body, still obscured by the purple smoke, seemed too big for her to see at a glance.
[What kind of bluff are you... Ah!]
Zephyrin noticed something wrong when 'magic' began to leak out of the energy barriers that Murakan had spread on her left and right.
He intended to return the breath absorbed by the barriers to her.
Energy, or shadow.
Its power was not only more than twice as efficient as aura or magic. It also possessed a special characteristic that ordinary power could never imitate.
Imitating or duplicating something like a shadow being cast.
The principle behind Murakan returning Zephyrin's breath through the barriers was precisely that.
'I didn't want to use this because it's that guy's way.'
It wasn't Murakan's preferred method. In the past, he had such strong power that it would have been acceptable to treat this characteristic of energy as a mere trick, so there was no need to use it.
On the other hand, Misha, as she demonstrated since her first encounter with Jin, was proficient in handling the infinite scalability of energy.
'I never thought I'd use what I was forced to learn when that damn guy harassed me like this. If I hadn't regained even 40% of my strength, this would have been impossible.'
Hmph! Murakan snorted as he wiped away the hideous image of Misha that popped into his head.
Sssshhh!
The barriers spread on both sides emitted a sharp noise and fired magic.
The magic was enhanced by the energy, making it more powerful than the breath Zephyrin had released. Dodging the magic with Zephyrin's giant body was impossible.
[Ha! Where did you learn such a wicked thing...!]
There was no time to deploy a shield.
Her massive body size was mostly advantageous in battle, but in the face of such unexpected attacks, it was inevitably inconvenient to respond.
As the magic struck Zephyrin's body, a heavy, deafening sound like a collapsing fortress echoed. Scales shattered, and the sound of twisted flesh and bone hidden beneath made one's hair stand on end.
Grrraaah...!
A scream that seemed impossible to hear continued.
[It's probably the first time you've been hit by your own breath, huh? Isn't it?]
Murakan spoke in an evil voice filled with laughter, and Zephyrin writhed in pain for a while.
She reflexively swung her tail, spewed breath in all directions, and expelled magic like a madman, staining the air like a poison swamp.
Murakan and Shaku heightened their senses while avoiding Zephyrin's rampage. Even a simple movement from Zephyrin could inflict fatal wounds on them.
Both of them, narrowly dodging the magic, swinging tail, and body, had the same thought in mind.
Now might be the best, or perhaps the last opportunity they could have in this battle.
Even Valkas, who was only protecting the Black Knight, could not miss this moment and threw himself into the battlefield for a while.
The three of them, with bloodshot eyes, searched for open wounds. They had to inflict additional damage through the wounds caused by magic before Zephyrin could recover.
Shaku screamed and dropped lightning, while Valkas exerted all his strength and launched an attack.

The moment lightning and the attack hit where the scales had burst, a terrible blood fountain unfolded before their eyes, which was shocking even to them who had experienced bloody battlefields throughout their lives.
Phwooosh-!
A waterfall of blood gushed from between Zephyrin's torn flesh. The blood contained the same poison that had put the Black Knight into a coma.
Finally, Murakan penetrated the poison and flew into the wound that Valkas and Shaku had opened.
It was a location, equivalent to the abdomen in humans, around the middle of the giant body. In other words, it was a vital point that anyone could see.
Murakan released a breath with all his strength into the wound, which was so deep it looked like a cave.
Soon, a brilliant black line pierced through Zephyrin's body.
It could be described as if the waist had been cut off. Everyone in the group sensed Zephyrin's spine breaking under Murakan's breath.
Huff, hoo, hah...!
Murakan took a heavy breath and steadied himself in midair. Valkas and Shaku stood below, catching their breaths as well.
The once incredibly noisy battlefield became quiet enough to hear the group's ragged breathing.
It was an extremely short silence. Zephyrin, motionless with her body bent backward, snorted and lifted her head, taking a breath.
[...Wow, this is truly surprising?]
Magic from all directions gathered, filling the gaping hole in the abdomen. The regeneration speed was too fast; there was no way to do anything about it.
[I can't even remember the last time I felt this much pain.]
It wasn't that she had not been hit at all.

Murakan was sure of that. It was something impossible even for him in his prime. However, he also judged that although Zephyrin had suffered damage, it was not at a level that would hinder her from continuing the battle.
‘I've got a seriously nasty one.’
The only silver lining was that Jin's mental concentration to cut the void space had just ended.
His mind had been distracted by the unexpected impact and pain. Zephyrin's pupils darkened as she saw the blue flame burning brightly in Bradamante, along with the energy.
Swoosh!
Bradamante's blade drew a blue, sharp trajectory in the dark void space.
Then, as if a dimensional gate had opened, the void space expanded, revealing the figure of Inse.
Beyond it was the reception room where the group had been, and all the furnishings were intact without any damage.
And the next moment.
The group was able to discover one of Zephyrin's weaknesses they had not expected.
‘As soon as I cut the void space, her body is shrinking...!’
They could intuitively sense it.
Zephyrin could only transform into her true form within this void space.
